response.justification: While Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with strong architectural, testing, and mentoring skills, he falls significantly short of the core technical requirements for this role. The position explicitly requires 8 years of C++ programming and deep expertise in building low-level, large-scale compute infrastructure. Bogdan's background is primarily in web technologies, TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with less than a year of professional C++ experience.
strengths: Extensive experience in software design, architecture, and rigorous testing practices including TDD and CI/CD.
Proven track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and organizing engineering workshops and dojos.
Demonstrated ability to build and scale microservices handling high throughput, such as his work with DLang at Dunnhumby.
concerns: Severely lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming experience, possessing only about 7 months of professional C++ exposure.
Missing deep, low-level experience with hardware architecture, storage, and foundational cloud compute technologies.
Recent technical focus heavily leans toward full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than core infrastructure engineering.
